summary: Test suite provides solid unit tests for core matrix generation logic but is critically incomplete and fails to meet core task requirement. Missing: .github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml, fixtures/basic.json, fixtures/with-include-exclude.json, fixtures/exceeds-max.json. Task explicitly requires 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' — this is impossible without the workflow and fixture files. New-EnvironmentMatrix.Tests.ps1 covers basic functionality (cartesian product, include/exclude, max-parallel, fail-fast, max-size validation) and some error cases (null config, missing 'os'/'version' keys) but omits critical edge cases: empty array validation (code checks for this but no test), PSCustomObject input type (implementation supports it via ConvertTo-PlainHashtable, zero tests), missing 'flags' key validation (incomplete error coverage). verify-act-output.ps1 and Test-WorkflowStructure.ps1 are well-designed validators that correctly assert workflow structure and exact output matching, but both are non-functional without the missing workflow and fixtures they reference. Unit tests are readable and well-organized into contexts, but lack fixture sharing and helper functions. No tests verify exact error message format or output structure for GitHub Actions compatibility. Cannot assess integration coverage at all.
